verdict.rationale: The only support is vendor positioning: the launch release calls the X2 Elite Extreme the 'most efficient' Windows PC processor, and a community comment echoes a 'multi-day' battery-life claim. Qualcomm publishes no TDP or power figure and leaves power envelopes to OEMs, so the efficiency claim cannot be checked. Missing for 10: any evidence of shipping fanless or thin-and-light designs, independent or hands-on battery-life measurements, published power/TDP figures, and named OEM laptops with battery results.
